metadata.description: Composite index prioritizing transit routes for service review based on supply-side scheduling gaps and network connectivity.

network_connectivity.name: Transfer Exposure
network_connectivity.business_rationale: Routes connecting to higher numbers of distinct corridors have greater passenger exchange potential and systemic network importance.

off_peak_gap.name: Off-Peak Service Vulnerability
off_peak_gap.business_rationale: Long off-peak intervals (low off-peak trip count relative to peak) highlight severe supply starvation during midday and evening hours.

weekend_deficit.name: Weekend Service Deficit
weekend_deficit.business_rationale: Weekday-only commuter routes leave weekend travelers with direct connectivity gaps, representing supply blind spots.

stop_density.name: Corridor Stop Coverage
stop_density.business_rationale: High stop density indicates arterial trunk corridors carrying local boarding access across multiple neighborhoods.
